observation.command:
set -e
curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x -o /tmp/nodesource_setup.sh
bash /tmp/nodesource_setup.sh >/tmp/node_setup.log 2>&1
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nodejs >/tmp/node_install.log 2>&1
node --version
npm --version
corepack --version 2>/dev/null || echo "no corepack"
